title: No 4-cycle, least top-form AND/OR circuit with one junk AND g: edges, a cover, mixing and cone OR gates, twice the centreless tops, at most gates plus |U*| + 1
formal_statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → G.edgeFinset.Nonempty → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsLeastAO G C →
  PEqualNP.TopForm.TopForm G C → ∀ (g : ℕ), PEqualNP.TopForm.junk G C = {g} →
    ∃ K : Finset (Fin n), (∀ e ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.starEdges G C, ∃ v ∈ K, v ∈ e) ∧
      PEqualNP.TopForm.formU G C g ⊆ K ∧ PEqualNP.TopForm.formZ G C g ⊆ K ∧
      G.edgeFinset.card + K.card + (PEqualNP.TopForm.pen G C g K).card + 1 +
        (PEqualNP.TopForm.mixing G C).card + 2 * (PEqualNP.TopForm.centreless G C).card +
        (PEqualNP.TopForm.coneGates G C g).card ≤
      C.size + (PEqualNP.TopForm.Ustar G C).card + 1
plain_statement: Let G have an edge and no 4-cycle, and C be a fewest-gate circuit of AND/OR gates, each reading exactly two earlier wires, computing the edge function of G (1 iff some edge has both ends 1), in top form, whose only AND gate not below that function is g. Then some vertex set K covers every star edge and holds the root's formU(g) and formZ(g), and |E| + |K| + |pen(g, K)| + 1 + (mixing gates) + 2 (centreless tops) + |coneGates(g)| is at most the number of gates plus |U*| + 1, with these names as defined on the definitions root.
